title: Nonnegative Laplacian at a unit-sphere minimum
source_anchor: standard second-order necessary conditions and unit-sphere exponential curves
target_statement: At a global minimum on the unit sphere, a finite trace of tangent exponential-curve second derivatives is nonnegative. Formula: \Delta f(w)=\sum_i \frac{d^2}{dt^2}f(\operatorname{Exp}_w(tz_i))\big|_{t=0}\ge0
